rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXLII Of Religion of Native
rules.historical_meaning_only: This is a new numbered chapter, separate from travel risk/regions, starting lower original PDF645.
Saturn ninth is an allegedly adverse religious-disposition source ingredient, not a universal rule alone.
Mars ninth is an alternative traditional adverse ingredient.
South lunar node is also listed as a separate adverse ingredient; glyph to verify against source.
Saturn third opposing ninth is a further alternative source condition.
Mars third is an alternative to Saturn third.
Source adverse configuration additionally invokes movable zodiac signs.
The general adverse religious conclusion depends on the planet called Jupiter being weak in the source rubric.
Peregrine dignity is an additional/alternative source form of Jupiter weakness.
Jupiter in detriment is a different negative dignity condition.
Jupiter's cadent house position further qualifies negative testimony.
Author further conditions case on adverse contact with malefics.
Period Christian valuation of religiosity is alleged, not a scientific observation about faith.
The source allows weak or no practice/faith as alternative outcomes, not a unique target.
Source also offers change from childhood religion as different endpoint.
A pejorative sectarian theological label is applied by source; never infer about a real person.
Jupiter ninth/third is presented as an allegedly favorable source alternative.
Venus ninth/third is another author-favorable historical sign.
An additional northern-node glyph appears in the positive trio and should be independently verified.
The source's positive verdict explicitly assumes a seventeenth-century Christian standard, not universal moral worth.
The claimed outcome refers specifically to attachment to upbringing religion, not any faith.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun Moon Mercury in those houses
rules.historical_meaning_only: Solar/lunar/Mercury positions are described as moderate testimony in third/ninth.
A further source glyph for Part of Fortune is listed among intermediate markers, requiring glyph collation.
These placements are specifically called moderate rather than necessarily decisive.
Favorable Jupiter/Venus aspects allegedly augment the already moderate testimony.
Malefic aspects are said to lessen the same positive disposition claim.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: if no Planets third or ninth
rules.historical_meaning_only: Explicit fallback arises only when the two relevant houses are empty.
The fallback source chooses Jupiter as a natural religious significator, not arbitrary strongest planet.
Jupiter domicile is one favorable condition in the fallback.
Jupiter exaltation is an alternative essential dignity source.
A further angular condition boosts the favorable Jupiter fallback.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Reception with Venus Sun Moon Mercury
rules.historical_meaning_only: Mutual reception with any of four named objects is another source favorable Jupiter fallback.
The source alleges a historical positive character/religiosity result without actual participant evidence.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter peregrine Fall Detriment Cadent afflicted
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author gives a contrary verdict if Jupiter is weak/afflicted in the fallback.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: would not have any man to think
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly explicitly introduces a limiting clarification against misunderstanding his astrology as controlling faith.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: influence of Starres enforceth this or that Religion
rules.historical_meaning_only: Lilly says stars do NOT enforce a particular religious belief; contrary to any deterministic religion rule.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: nor Causers one being Religious or contrary
rules.historical_meaning_only: He also denies the stars cause a person to be religious or not religious.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: grace of God effects Piety and Godliness
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author attributes piety to divine grace, a historical theological assertion, not a scientific mechanism.
He limits astrology's claimed use to interpreting a natural inclination toward good or ill.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: whether permanent or not in either
rules.historical_meaning_only: He adds an alleged indication of persistence, which differs from causing conversion or being religious.
This clarification and surrounding claims do not supply tested religion/behavior classification.
An internal unnumbered heading within printed CXLII changes to listed piety conditions.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter Venus or North Node ninth or third
rules.historical_meaning_only: A repeated benefic/node placement is asserted as one piety source condition.
The author names fixed star Spica, with natal aspect/proximity not fully specified.
Historical self/other religious characterization, no independent evidence.
The text has ambiguous Cazimi/planet glyph juxtaposition requiring careful transcription before astronomical coding.
Lilly alleges propensity for prophecy from an uncertain configuration, without objective supernatural evidence.
Divinatory ability is a second distinct claimed result, unsupported by controlled experiments.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun Moon Mercury Part Fortune ninth or third
rules.historical_meaning_only: A group of lights/Mercury/Part Fortune in third/ninth is said to support moderate religious disposition.
Source admits intermediate/moderate rather than always extremely devout verdict.
Sun ninth is separately alleged to indicate strong piety.
A solar-ninth case predicts strong piety without a measurement instrument.
The author adds institutional religious advancement as a different outcome.
Quality of preaching is another speculative outcome, separate from actual belief.
A source positive case of Saturn in its essential dignities, explicitly contradicting a blanket Saturn-bad-faith inference.
Dignified Saturn ninth is said to indicate charity and faith rather than automatically impiety.
Benefic ruler of ninth is a separate source positive label.
A debilitated benefic ninth ruler modifies the outcome, not simply benefic always strong.
The author claims correct religious judgment despite ill disposition; moral/philosophical not measured.
Social acceptance of religious views is a second result distinct from correctness.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn or Mars ninth or third Direct

Fixed-sign placements of the benefic aspecting planets are additionally specified.
The source reverses usual malefic judgment under its stated composite positives.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: yet not so sincere and firme
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author qualifies even positive apparent piety as less secure than if benefics occupied those houses.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: as if Fortunes had been in their places
rules.historical_meaning_only: Benefics actually occupying houses is the comparison case for stronger sincerity.

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: Sun and Jupiter dominion in ninth

rules.original_anchor_not_diplomatic: many Planets ninth mixture of goodness
